info.title: Reviewer Roadtest API
info.description: Public hosted first-visit checks, read-only GenLayer receipt verification, and scoped evidence records. Hosted runs publish report JSON and screenshots; do not submit secrets. A signed wallet transaction is required only for a new GenLayer consensus review.

post.summary: Run a scoped plan in an isolated hosted browser
post.description: Only public HTTPS origins, accessible-role browser checks and same-origin public HTTP assertions are accepted. At most five browser and five HTTP checks. The report and screenshot are public.

200.description: Public report URL, SHA-256 and report
